capabilities.problem: Stock research can produce a plausible literature list without explicit coverage obligations, evidence levels, decision history, or a reasoned stop decision.
capabilities.mechanism: Define the bounded Stage 1 workflow and evidence obligations while retrieval, validation, and coverage execution remain separate later milestones.

hard_measures: identity status and evidence level are represented separately
claim evidence can reference a versioned artifact
metric_effects.human_judgment: A blinded AI judge applies the frozen rubric to whether central methods and findings are substantively supported; targeted human audit handles rubric triggers.

hard_measures: coverage obligations are declared
recent and closest-work checks are required before a sufficient stop
metric_effects.human_judgment: A blinded AI judge applies the frozen rubric to source equivalence and decision sufficiency; targeted human audit handles rubric triggers.

hard_measures: search actions and failures have artifact references
inclusion, exclusion, reversal, and human decisions retain reasons
metric_effects.human_judgment: A blinded AI judge applies the frozen rubric to whether the trace supports reconstruction and challenge.

guardrails: no benchmark answer key in production context
no executable-harness claim before retrieval and gates exist
bounded stage context

capabilities.problem: A contributor can otherwise add a plausible research capability without linking the observed failure, target metric, deterministic evidence, and live A/B decision.
capabilities.mechanism: Reject pull-request descriptions with unknown capability IDs, metric or rubric targets that disagree with the registries, missing evaluation evidence or guardrails, unreported external pull requests, an absent evidence-qualified improvement statement, an incorrect merge owner, or a missing skill test mini-report when a skill changes.

hard_measures: every pull request names a registered capability ID
declared pull-request metrics overlap the capability registry
declared rubric criteria exist and belong to declared metrics
per-pull-request metric evidence and the live A/B decision are recorded
related cross-repository pull requests are linked or explicitly recorded as absent
each pull request states whether improvement is demonstrated and names the current evidence
each pull request gives a one-sentence plain-language problem, change, and benefit summary
each executor reports complete, partial, or blocked status and identifies remaining work
the core team is recorded as the review and merge owner
every changed skill records its scenario, command, expected result, actual result, and limitations
metric_effects.human_judgment: The core team checks whether the proposed implementation evidence supports the claimed harness change; milestone scientific quality uses the blinded AI judge.

guardrails: does not convert deterministic test success into a scientific quality claim
does not expose the frozen benchmark answer key
does not permit an unregistered production capability

capabilities.problem: A JSON-schema-valid Stage 1 result can still contain impossible totals, ratios, efficiency counts, or adjudication states.
capabilities.mechanism: Apply cross-field semantic checks after structural schema validation and return explicit errors for inconsistent counts and judgment states.

hard_measures: bibliographic and claim count parts equal their totals
central source mismatch count is explicit
metric_effects.human_judgment: A blinded AI judge applies the frozen rubric to whether the verified source supports the central method and finding.

hard_measures: coverage numerators do not exceed denominators
recent work counts and latest-year state are internally consistent
metric_effects.human_judgment: A blinded AI judge applies the frozen rubric to closest-work and substitute-source sufficiency.

hard_measures: trace numerators do not exceed denominators
adjudicated status requires complete R1, R2, and ADJ scores
metric_effects.human_judgment: A blinded AI judge applies the frozen rubric to trace sufficiency.

guardrails: semantic validity is not reported as scientific quality improvement
structural JSON Schema validation runs before semantic validation
private benchmark answers are not read

capabilities.problem: A private holdout can become an undocumented title list, be changed after treatment results are seen, or be curated by one agent without independent human decisions.
capabilities.mechanism: Validate the six frozen clusters and curation roles, independent ratings, final inclusion decisions, classic and must-have rules, human approval records, normalized private-artifact declarations, and a canonical manifest hash.

hard_measures: all six clusters and roles are covered
classic and must-have eligibility rules pass
the manifest has a canonical SHA-256
metric_effects.human_judgment: Two human raters decide directness and inclusion; a separate human adjudicator resolves disagreement and the core team freezes the bundle.

hard_measures: every anchor retains two ratings and evidence IDs
frozen manifests record approvals and time
answer-key and approval artifacts are declared under normalized private paths
metric_effects.human_judgment: The core team checks that the preserved curation record is sufficient to challenge each anchor decision.

guardrails: real holdout contents stay under a separately controlled private path
this validator does not prove process isolation or artifact bytes; the evaluation runner must attest both
a passing contract does not prove human identity or scientific correctness
changing a frozen manifest requires a new ID and hash

capabilities.problem: Baseline and treatment can otherwise use different prompts, runtimes, judges, answer versions, run order, or success rules, making an apparent improvement impossible to interpret.
capabilities.mechanism: Freeze and validate the case, stage metrics, rubric and holdout hashes, prompt, builds, runtime, blinded judges, three alternating pairs, audit triggers, and conservative decision rule before execution.

hard_measures: stage metrics and target metrics are fixed and capability-aligned
rubric, catalog, capability registry, holdout, prompt, core revision, and extension diff are hash-bound
subject runtime, three run pairs, judge configs, audit triggers, and per-target decision constants are frozen
metric_effects.human_judgment: The core team chooses the scientific case, target metrics, real holdout, verifies external human identities and approval artifacts, and decides whether a completed audit supports an external claim.

guardrails: a valid plan is not a completed evaluation
synthetic plans cannot support scientific claims
the runner must attest prompt and answer bytes, opaque judge packets, approval identities, reviewed diff bytes, and process isolation
P1-P9 remain separate without a composite total
